app.name: BucketCat
app.tagline: Cross-platform object storage client · Tauri + React

sidebar.bucketRegionHint: This bucket is in {{region}}; requests are routed there automatically
sidebar.emptyHint: Click the + above to add your first connection
sidebar.cannotListBuckets: These credentials can't list buckets, so only the default bucket is shown.

main.selectBucketHint: Expand a connection on the left and click a bucket to browse
main.emptyHint: Drag files here, or use the Upload button
main.breadcrumbPlaceholder: Pick a bucket on the left to get started

objects.deleteBodyOne: Are you sure you want to delete "{{name}}"? This can't be undone.
objects.deleteBodyMany: Are you sure you want to delete the {{count}} selected objects? This can't be undone.
objects.deleteFolderBody: Are you sure you want to delete the folder "{{name}}" and everything inside it? Every object under this folder will be removed, and this can't be undone.
objects.invalidName: A name can't be empty or contain "/"
objects.nameExists: An object or folder with this name already exists here
objects.partialTitle: Some objects could not be deleted

upload.conflictTitle: Files with the same name already exist
upload.conflictBody: These {{count}} file(s) will overwrite objects in the current folder. Overwriting cannot be undone.
upload.dropHint: Drop to upload into this folder
upload.notReadyBody: Still checking for existing names in this folder. Please try again in a moment.

addConn.title: Add Connection
addConn.subtitle: Pick an object storage provider
addConn.name: Connection name
addConn.endpointGenericHint: Need a custom endpoint? Use the Generic S3 provider instead.
addConn.endpointCustomWarning: This connection uses a custom endpoint. Changing the region here will overwrite it.
addConn.rainyunRegionHint: Rainyun keys are per-region. Create a separate connection for each region.
addConn.secretKeep: Leave blank to keep the current secret
addConn.testNeedsSecret: Enter the secret key to test the connection

conn.deleteConfirmBody: Are you sure you want to delete "{{name}}"? Its buckets will no longer be reachable, and this can't be undone.

b2.keyIdHint: Create one under App Keys in the Backblaze console. The region is detected from it automatically.
b2.masterKeyWarning: That is a master application key ID (your account ID). Backblaze does not accept master keys on the S3-compatible API — create an application key under App Keys instead.
b2.applicationKeyHint: Shown only once, right after you create the application key.
b2.regionDerived: Region and endpoint detected from the keyID. Test connection confirms them against Backblaze.
b2.regionAwaitingKeyId: Enter your keyID above and the region fills in automatically.
b2.regionUnknown: Could not read a region from that keyID. Pick one, or copy the Endpoint shown on the Buckets page of the Backblaze console.
b2.regionEndpointMismatch: This connection's endpoint is not the one this keyID points at. Keeping it as-is is fine — pick a region only if you want to replace it.
b2.regionBlockedByMasterKey: A master key carries no region. Pick one manually, or switch to an application key.
b2.endpointCorrected: Connected. Backblaze reports this account is at {{endpoint}} — endpoint updated.

r2.credModeTokenHint: Paste one R2 API token — the access key and secret are derived from it, and it also unlocks bucket usage and public-access info.
r2.credModeKeysHint: Enter the S3 access key and secret directly. Bucket usage and public-access info stay unavailable without a token.
r2.apiTokenHint: Shown only once when you create the token in the Cloudflare dashboard.
r2.apiTokenKeep: Leave blank to keep the stored token.
r2.probeOk: Token valid — access key and account ID filled in.
r2.probeOkNoAccount: Token valid. It cannot list accounts, so enter the account ID below.
r2.probeRequired: Probe the token to fill in the access key.
r2.accessKeyDerived: Filled in by probing the token
r2.accountIdHint: The 32-character id in your R2 endpoint. Pasting the whole endpoint URL works too.
r2.accountRequired: Account ID is required to build the endpoint.
r2.jurisdictionHint: Each jurisdiction is a separate namespace — a connection only ever sees buckets created in the one you pick.

bucketInfo.title: Bucket info
bucketInfo.noToken: Add an R2 API token to this connection to see usage and public-access info.
bucketInfo.tokenDenied: This connection's API token is not allowed to read bucket settings.

settings.title: Settings
settings.closeToTrayHint: The app keeps running in the background; transfers in progress are not interrupted
settings.autostartHint: Starts silently into the tray, without opening a window
settings.presetHint: Conservative: fewest requests, best for rate-limited providers; Aggressive: highest concurrency, best for AWS/R2
settings.concurrencyHint: Total connections = {{total}}; too high may trigger throttling
settings.thresholdHint: Files smaller than this transfer as a single request, without splitting
settings.partSizeHint: Sets the concurrency granularity: smaller parts mean finer parallelism but more requests
settings.resumeTransfersHint: Continue unfinished transfers after a restart
settings.autoCheckUpdateHint: Only lights a dot on the settings entry -- no dialog interrupts you
settings.upToDate: You are on the latest version
settings.transfersBlockUpdate: {{count}} transfer(s) in progress -- finish or pause them before updating
settings.manualDownloadHint: This install cannot update itself; download the new version from the releases page
settings.author: Author

errors.auth/invalid-credentials: Invalid credentials -- check the access key and secret key
errors.auth/access-denied: Access denied -- check this account's permissions
errors.network/timeout: Connection timed out -- check your network and try again
errors.storage/wrong-region: This bucket is not in this connection's configured region -- check the connection's region setting
errors.storage/key-not-found: Object not found -- it may have been removed
errors.storage/connection-not-found: Connection not found -- it may have been removed
errors.local/decrypt-failed: Failed to decrypt the local connection store
errors.local/key-derivation-failed: Failed to derive the local store encryption key
errors.update/check-failed: Could not check for updates -- check your network and try again
errors.update/install-failed: Update install failed -- try again later or download it from the releases page
errors.internal: Something went wrong -- please try again
